text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board of Directors of CreateTO (the "Board") with a confidential update regarding the business plan for the City-owned property at 260 Adelaide Street West (“260 Adelaide”).

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 1, 2020) from the Vice President, Stakeholder and Client Relationship Management, CreateTO, as amended in closed session. 2. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 1, 2020) from the Vice President, Stakeholder and Client Relationship Management, CreateTO. 3. Endorsed the business and redevelopment plan for 229 Richmond Street West, outlined in Appendices 3 and 5 of the Confidential Attachment to the report (December 1, 2020) from the Vice President, Stakeholder and Client Relationship Management, CreateTO. 4.
